_intake_note: Opus subagent findings, 2026-08-19. Evidence-first inspection of shallow clone. Basis marks preserved. Condensed from the agent's full report; claims and evidence locators verbatim.
purpose: Answers natural-language questions about the kinetics of biochemical pathways by having an LLM pick a curated BioModels model and a named analysis type, having a coding agent (kiro-cli) write COPASI simulation code, executing it, and having a multimodal model turn the numeric output and plots into a report. README frames the goal as 'provably correct' responses grounded in a simulator rather than LLM recall (README.md:1-10, 98-100). The shipped mechanism is not proof: it is execute-then-LLM-critique, with LLM judges as the gates (engine.py:293-312, 442-461).

symbolic_layer.formalism: Deterministic kinetic simulation of SBML biochemical reaction networks — COPASI via copasi-basico. Available symbolic operations are systems-biology task primitives, not logic: time course, steady state, metabolic control analysis, scaled sensitivities, species clamping, timed events. No theorem prover, planner, logic engine or ontology anywhere in the repo.
symbolic_layer.position_in_loop: Post-generation execution + evidence production, not verification of the final claim. The simulator turns LLM-written code into numbers and PNGs that later LLM steps summarize and are judged against. The gates are LLM classifiers. Partial exception: non-empty stderr or non-zero exit mechanically forces a repair round — the interpreter is a hard gate on EXECUTABILITY only (engine.py:252-266).
symbolic_layer.what_it_guarantees: SOURCE_EXPLICIT intent: 'provably correct', 'a reliable system from a hybrid collection of unreliable components' (README.md:7, 98-100). REVIEWER_INFERENCE delivered: on normal termination, the numbers/plots were produced by a real COPASI execution of a named BioModels model, and the report ships source+stdout as appendices. Nothing guarantees the code encodes the question's intended perturbation, the prose faithfully reports the numbers, or the model/analysis choice is right — each checked only by another LLM whose verdict is a True/False string parsed from a ```result block.

llm_layer.models: One Bedrock id for every in-process inference: global.anthropic.claude-opus-4-6-v1 (engine.py:23), used as LLM and as LMM (plots base64). All simulation code written/edited by kiro-cli subprocess, model unspecified in-repo.
llm_layer.role: Six jobs: select BioModels id from curated list; select analysis type; repair code from stderr; multimodal critique of code+plots vs question; classify critique as needs-work (twice: code and report); write and revise the markdown report.

interaction_pattern: Two nested propose->execute->critique->repair loops, both gated by an LLM classifier reading a ```result True/False block. Loop A (code): run -> on stderr/exit!=0, LLM-repair and re-run up to max_fix_attempts=10 -> multimodal critique vs question + chosen analysis type -> LLM classifies -> if needs work, kiro-cli rewrites simulation.py and loop repeats. Loop B (report): summarize -> critique vs question/analysis/code/stdout/plots -> classify -> rewrite; capped at 5. Asymmetries: Loop A has NO iteration cap; Loop A's exit-on-empty-critique path returns None which would fail the 4-tuple unpack in generate() (engine.py:342-351 vs 588-589, REVIEWER_INFERENCE).
biology_angle: The biology is the ACTION SPACE, not just the topic. analysis-types.yaml encodes four in-silico experimental protocols a systems biologist would run (metabolic control analysis, knockout by clamping, scaled sensitivity, pulse response), each written as the question it answers. The agent's first two decisions are biological modelling decisions made before any code exists: which published reaction network (BioModels accession) and which perturbation protocol. Knockout is operationalised as a modeller would: set_species(..., initial_concentration=0, status='fixed') plus paired WT/KO time course (example-code.yaml:1-28). The chosen analysis type propagates as a constraint into code generation AND both critique prompts ('is it clamping the right one', prompts.yaml:40-48, 69-73). What is NOT here: no experimental/literature data retrieved or compared; no hypothesis object, no predicted-vs-observed comparison, no accept/reject of a biological claim. The loop closes over the ARTIFACT (does this code/report answer the question?), never over the BIOLOGY (does the model reproduce reality?).

research_loop.state_persistence: Within a single run only: runs/<uuid4>/<N>_<key>.<ext> — complete ordered append-only trace of one run (every prompt, response, code version, execution result, report revision) plus numbered sandbox dirs. Across runs: NOTHING. No index, no DB, no graph, no reuse. NOT_ESTABLISHED that any cross-run state exists.
research_loop.audit_trail: Partial, degrading at the last step. Strong: report appends verbatim source, stdout, stderr, plots as collapsible appendices; on-disk artifact chain replayable. Weak (REVIEWER_INFERENCE): (1) report revision round-trips through the LLM and appendices can silently disappear — the shipped sample report has none (engine.py:463-482 vs assets/sample-run-final-summary-report.md); (2) the llm_call provenance event is declared in schema, typed in frontend, marked done in tasks.md, but never emitted by event_adapter.py; (3) the UI run_id and the artifact-dir uuid are two different uuids, so the visible id does not locate the evidence on disk.

key_concepts.definition: A named in-silico experiment chosen before any code exists, then carried as a constraint into code generation and both critique prompts.

key_concepts.concept: Curated model whitelist with explicit refusal path
key_concepts.definition: LLM may only pick a BioModels id from a 3-entry table; 'None' becomes a terminal refusal rather than a guess.
Fix concentration at 0, status='fixed', diff paired WT/KO time courses.
Tracebacks fixed by text LLM; does-it-answer-the-question judged by separate multimodal critique.

claims_selected.claim: The system provides 'provably correct' answers about pathway kinetics.

Nothing establishes provability: no proof obligation, no formal property over scientific output, no test suite; every correctness gate is an LLM classifying its own critique. Only mechanical check: exit 0 + empty stderr.
A reliable system can be assembled from unreliable components.

resonances: Typed KG: NOT_ESTABLISHED (no graph, triples, entity store). Ontology-gated writes: two partial analogues — (a) closed vocabularies (3 curated models, 4 analysis types) with an explicit None->refusal path: genuine vocabulary gating on generation, but the WRITE is never validated (extract_result_block returns None unchecked; hallucinated accession trips a late KeyError; Metabolic_Control_Analysis is legal-but-broken); (b) SSE event schema is a real closed Pydantic schema. Bitemporal state: NOT_ESTABLISHED; nearest analogue is strict append-only monotonic artifact numbering within a run — single-axis revision history, no valid/transaction time, no cross-run identity. Grounded audit rationales: partial and leaking — report built to carry its own grounding but the revision step can drop appendices (shipped sample has none); llm_call provenance event never emitted. Dedup-gated exploration: NOT_ESTABLISHED (only a frontend history includes() check). Closed research loop with promotion/rejection: the SHAPE is present (critique-then-classify decides advance-or-retry) but the decision is an LLM's, the rationale has no typed link to the decision, and the loop closes over code and prose, never over a biological hypothesis: no hypothesis entity, no prediction, no comparison against experimental data. Pre-registered methodology: STRONGEST resonance — (1) analysis-types.yaml is a pre-registered menu of named methods committed before code exists and injected into both critique prompts, so the reviewer judges fidelity to the pre-committed protocol; (2) design.md:349-393 is a literal pre-registration of seven numbered correctness properties — but they constrain only GUI plumbing, and no test implementing any of them exists.
